title: Newmark Establishes National Industrial Project Management Leadership Role, Appoints Dana Miarmi
summary: Newmark announces that Dana Miarmi has joined the firm as Vice President, Project Management, National Industrial Lead.
body_markdown:
**September 1, 2026 9:00 AM**


Newmark announces that[Dana Miarmi](https://www.nmrk.com/people/dana-miarmi) has joined the firm as Vice President, Project Management, National Industrial Lead. In the newly created role, Miarmi will collaborate with professionals across the country to drive business development, lead client strategy and deliver integrated solutions for occupiers, developers and investors executing complex capital projects.


###


“Today’s industrial projects require strategic advisors who understand how facilities, operations and real estate intersect,” said[Eric Brown](https://www.nmrk.com/people/eric-brown) , Head of Project Management, Americas. “Dana brings a rare combination of technical expertise, operational insight and client leadership that will strengthen our ability to deliver integrated project management solutions nationwide. Her appointment reinforces our commitment to expanding our business and delivering greater value to industrial clients.”


“As industrial facilities become increasingly specialized – including advanced manufacturing, logistics, cold storage, food and beverage, aviation and mission-critical operations – clients require advisors that understand complex development challenges,” said[Jack Fraker](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jack-fraker) , President, Global Head of Industrial and Logistics, Capital Markets. “Expanding our suite of offerings is a natural evolution of how we’re serving the market and responding to the strategic expertise our clients increasingly require.”


A Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt and LEED Accredited Professional, Miarmi joins Newmark with more than two decades of experience leading industrial business development, client strategy and project delivery across North America. Most recently, she served as National Industrial Lead within Project & Development Services (PDS) at JLL, where she led national industrial growth initiatives, served as top sales generator for PDS several years in a row and advised clients across logistics, manufacturing, aviation, cold storage and supply chain infrastructure. Throughout her career, she has helped organizations reduce costs, optimize operations and successfully deliver complex industrial capital projects.


“I’m excited to join Newmark and help build upon the firm’s growing Project Management business,” said Miarmi. “Industrial clients are facing increasingly sophisticated operational and development challenges that require integrated, end-to-end solutions, and Newmark’s collaborative platform brings capabilities together in a way that creates meaningful value throughout the lifecycle of a project.”


The appointment comes as the U.S. industrial market continues to demonstrate resilience and strong underlying fundamentals. According to Newmark Research, leasing activity increased 12.3% year over year in the first quarter of 2026, while net absorption outpaced new deliveries for the first time since 2022. Investment sales also accelerated 48% year over year, underscoring continued demand for high-quality industrial assets as occupiers and investors remain focused on modern logistics and manufacturing facilities.


**About Newmark**
Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark’s comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of more than $3.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from over 195 offices with more than 10,000 professionals across four continents.
